facts.material: chemically modified starch (Cato Size 52A / 15A), starch origin not stated

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 3505 covers dextrins and other modified starches; heading 3809 covers finishing agents not elsewhere specified
GRI 6: 3505.10.00 other modified starches, statistical suffix Other

rejected_alternatives.reason: G81194 classified Cato 52A/15A here as formulated sizing preparations but it is revoked with no replacement listed; description says modified starches, which heading 3505 names

missing_facts: Starch source (corn, potato, other) only affects the statistical suffix
classification.rationale: The goods are described as modified starches, named in heading 3505. The only matching ruling G81194 put them in 3809.92.50 as preparations, but it is revoked and no replacement was returned, so it is not relied on. Suffix 92 is the residual line.
